cohort: Women undergoing delivery in a Brazilian referral maternity hospital between January 2009 and August 2022.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate in the hospital increased over time (from 46.23% in 2009 to 62.99% in 2022), with Robson Groups 1-4, 5, and 10 significantly contributing to this increase.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate, as a mode of birth, significantly increased over the decade across all Robson groups, particularly in groups 1-4, 5, and 10.
